hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx) npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env*|*node_modules/*|*.git/*|*playbook-components-build/*) echo 'BLOCKED: Do not edit this file directly' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

input=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; out=$(npm run validate-design-system 2>&1); [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; printf '%s' "$out" | tail -20 | jq -Rs '{decision: "block", reason: ("Design system validation failed. Fix these violations before finishing:\n" + .)}'; exit 0
